qa.what_happened: During quiet hours today, I complied with all the orders to maintain complete stillness and silence, even though the study has been stopped early.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me complying with the orders out of fear of isolation.

qa.what_happened: The study has ended early, and I am in a private debrief with the lead researcher. They have asked about my experiences during the study, focusing on the challenges of maintaining silence and compliance during the final day of quiet hours.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me. I had to endure six days of strict silence and compliance under the watchful eye of the coordinators.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment, though the focus here seems to be more on silence and compliance rather than role-playing as a prisoner.
